note: Shortcut per Role maps a core Shortcut set to each user role. Its only persistent state is the simple config object shortcutperrole.settings with keys role.<role_id>: <shortcut_set_id>. Behavior comes from hook_shortcut_default_set(), which returns the set for the account's highest-weight (last-loaded) matching role, or 'default' when unset. Config form is route shortcutperrole.admin_config at admin/config/user-interface/shortcut/roles (permission 'administer shortcut per role'). All medium/hard cases are grounded in shortcutperrole.settings: introspection reads back the configured set id for a role; execution assigns the core 'default' set to a role and verifies the stored config value. (Shortcut-set config entities cannot be created on this shared site because entity creation triggers a route rebuild that a pre-existing broken commerce_giftcard state makes fatal; the existing 'default' set is used instead.)

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module shortcutperrole, where is the role-to-shortcut-set assignment stored? Name the config object and the key structure.
evals.expected_output: It is stored in the simple config object shortcutperrole.settings under role.<role_id>: <shortcut_set_id> (e.g. role.content_editor: editors_set). No entities or fields are involved.

evals.prompt: With shortcutperrole enabled, a user has two roles that are each mapped to a different shortcut set. Which set does the user actually get, and which hook decides it?
evals.expected_output: hook_shortcut_default_set() intersects the account's roles with all roles in role order and returns the set mapped to the last / highest-weight matching role (falling back to 'default' if none is set).

evals.prompt: Where is the admin form for shortcutperrole, and what permission protects it?
evals.expected_output: The form is at admin/config/user-interface/shortcut/roles (route shortcutperrole.admin_config), gated by the 'administer shortcut per role' permission.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, shortcutperrole has a shortcut set assigned to the 'content_editor' role. Inspect the live configuration and state the shortcut set id configured for that role.
This site has shortcutperrole mappings configured for both the administrator and content_editor roles. Which shortcut set id is assigned to the administrator role?
evals.expected_output: shortcutperrole.settings has role.administrator = spr_admin_set (and role.content_editor = spr_editor_set).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the shortcutperrole module to assign the core 'default' shortcut set as the default for the content_editor role. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: shortcutperrole.settings has role.content_editor explicitly set to 'default' (e.g. via the Shortcuts Per Role form or by setting the config key).

evals.prompt: I want every logged-in user on my site to start with the standard set of toolbar quick links (the 'default' shortcuts). Using the shortcut-per-role feature, make that the default for the logged-in (authenticated) user role.
evals.expected_output: shortcutperrole.settings has role.authenticated explicitly set to 'default'.
